# matris.app

> Dinner ideas from matprat.no and godt.no, ranked by this week's grocery offers. Diet rules and allergies (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, milk-free, no onion, low FODMAP, pregnant, the EU allergens, ...) apply when a search names them, and the offers are from the stores near a place when `sted` names one; until then, from stores all over Norway.

The site is in Norwegian (bokmål). Recipes belong to matprat.no and godt.no; link to them, do not copy them. Offers are from the stores' weekly catalogs. What an ingredient holds (gluten, onion, lactose, the allergens, meat, FODMAP, ...) was judged by a small language model and can be wrong; tell people to check the label.

## Start here

Each link below is the list of dinners for one diet rule, the most kroner off first. Every answer has `links`: `add` and `remove` give the same answer with one more rule or one fewer, and `dinners` the full list for the same search. Combine rules by following those links, one rule at a time; you never need to write a URL yourself. With no rules: [every dinner]({{ base }}api/middager).

{% for diet, url in rule_links %}- [{{ diet }}]({{ url }})
{% endfor %}
Ask where the person shops. Each link below is the list with the offers from the stores near one place; `links.places` in every answer does the same for any search:

{% for place, url in place_links %}- [{{ place }}]({{ url }})
{% endfor %}
## JSON API

Read-only, no key, CORS open. `{{ base }}api` redirects to the schema. Keys are English; advice is bokmål; prices are kroner.

- [OpenAPI schema]({{ base }}api/openapi.json): every endpoint and field
- [Search the dinners that fit]({{ base }}api/middager?q=rask+kylling+uten+sopp): best first; only dinners with at least 20 kr off are listed. `q` is a search in plain bokmål: diet rules and allergies ({{ diets }}; they decide which dinners fit, nothing is swapped, and a rule that leaves something out also leaves out ingredients that may hold it), categories (`under 20 min`, `på tilbud`, `godt likt`, `barnevennlig`), main proteins ({{ proteins }}; also `kjøtt`, `sjømat`), `uten X` to leave X out, `X eller Y` for either, and any word in the dish name or an ingredient. Typos are fixed and reported in `search.corrected`; `search.understood` says how `q` was read, and `search.query` is the same search written out. `sted` is the place whose stores' offers count, and `antall` is 1-100.
- [One recipe]({{ base }}api/oppskrift?url=https://www.matprat.no/oppskrifter/familien/lasagne/): whether it fits, and why not. The ingredients and method are on matprat.no or godt.no; link there

## Method

- Dinners with the most kroner off every ingredient on sale, the cheapest offer of each, come first, then rating and prep time.
- A dinner is on sale when its main protein (the heaviest meat or fish; without one, a main vegetable) has a before-price in this week's catalog, at the stores near the place searched for or, without one, at any store.
- [How it works, in Norwegian]({{ base }}om)
